name: Vernograph
summary:
A windowed Home app displaying a sculptural copper infinity cube with spatial stereo depth, fitted with steam-era instruments, evoking Jules Verne’s age of invention.

Vernograph sits in your space as a living instrument panel—not a flat utility sheet. Read the time and date, watch battery level rise and fall, and see pack heat and headset thermal stress at a glance, rendered as brass-and-copper machinery you can anchor on a wall. The background mood shifts with the hour—from dawn light to evening dusk.
